messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Usual Pediatric Dose for Generalized Anxiety Disorder:
7 to 17 years: -Initial dose: 30 mg orally once a day for at least 2 weeks -Maintenance dose: 30 to 60 mg orally once a day -Maximum dose: 120 mg/day.
Usual Pediatric Dose for Fibromyalgia:
13 years and older: -Initial dose: 30 mg orally once a day for at least 1 week -Maintenance dose: 30 to 60 mg orally once a day.
Triplet: ["Duloxetine", "has pediatric dose", "7 to 17 years"]

The relation 'has pediatric dose' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is prescribed for the pediatric age group specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
